questions.markdown: A unit-step response test conducted on a second order system yielded peak overshoot, $M_p=0.15$, and peak time $t_p=0.2\,\text{s}$. Obtain the corresponding response indices, $M_r$, $\omega_r$, $\omega_b$ for the system.

For a unity feedback control system, the open loop transfer function

$$
G(s)=\frac{10(s+2)}{s^2(s+1)}.
$$

Find the steady state error when the input,

$$
R(s)=\frac{3}{s}+\frac{1}{3s^3}.
$$

A system has

$$
G(S)H(S)=\frac{75}{S(1+TS)(1+0.5S)}.
$$

Determine the value of $T$ such that the system is driven to the verge of instability. Also calculate the resulting frequency of oscillation.

Examine whether the system characterized by the differential equation

$$
\ddot{Y}+8\ddot{Y}+13\dot{Y}+7Y+U=0
$$

is controllable and observable using Kalman's method.
